episode.title: This GIANT LION Is NOT Real

synopsis: On a minimal studio desert set, a colossal lion takes a performer into its mouth, then the crew force its practical jaws open and he steps out unharmed.

shots.prompt:
ONE CONTINUOUS TAKE, NO CUTS. The camera is low and close, so the giant creature fills the whole frame from the very first second, its head and jaws reaching past the edges of the picture. One dark production element stays at the bottom edge of the frame, an out-of-focus crew head or the corner of a camera rig or a flight case, and the blue screen wall with its pale blue cross tracking markers sits far behind the creature and reads out of focus, so the shot still reads as a film set. A shallow depth of field keeps the creature's head sharp while everything behind it falls away. A hard directional lamp rakes the creature from one side and lays real shadows, while the space behind the creature stays darker than the creature itself. One giant creature faces exactly one man. The creature's jaws open wide and close over him until he is completely out of sight inside its mouth. Crew members rush in, put their hands on the creature and push its jaws open, and in the final seconds the same one man climbs out onto the set floor unharmed, showing that the creature is a built practical prop rather than a living animal. The camera stays close and handheld throughout, drifting with the action, with natural motion blur.

On a desert_ruins_set, Ihsan stands before A colossal, tawny-golden lion with thick, shaggy mane, piercing amber eyes, sharp white fangs, a scarred nose, and standing eight meters tall. The lion's head dominates the frame, its wide-open jaws are menacing, and Ihsan is contained within its mouth. Crew members, wearing dark clothing and gloves, grasp the lion's lower jaw and push it down with visible effort to reveal the interior mechanism. Ihsan then steps out onto the set floor, his movements showing his sound physical condition. Ambient sound only: footsteps on sand, studio air handling and crew movement.
shots.violation_observation: The giant lion's mouth closes over the man until his whole body is hidden inside it, then crew members put their hands on the giant lion and force its mouth open, and the same man climbs out onto the set floor.
